map.Code128 和 EAN-13 该怎么选？: How to choose between Code128 and EAN-13?
map.内部物流、含字母或长度不定的编号用 Code128；零售商品且已申请 GS1 厂: Use Code128 for internal logistics and codes containing letters or variable length; use EAN-13/UPC for retail products that already hold a GS1 manufacturer code. The two must not be mixed, and scanners must be configured to match.
map.商品入库/出库贴码：把内部货号或 EAN-13 数字生成条码图片，打印后贴于包装: Goods labelling on inbound or outbound stock: turn an internal item number or EAN-13 digits into a barcode image, print it and stick it on the packaging for scanner entry.
map.多为静区不足、打印分辨率低或对比度不够。保证白底黑条、DPI≥300、静区完整，: Usually caused by insufficient quiet zones, low print resolution or weak contrast. Keep white background with black bars, DPI of at least 300 and complete quiet zones, and enable the matching symbology when scanning on a phone.
map.支持Code128、EAN-13、UPC-A、Code39等多种码制，纯前端生成: Supports Code128, EAN-13, UPC-A, Code39 and other symbologies, generated purely front-end and downloadable
map.教学演示码制差异：对比 Code128（可变长字母数字）与 EAN-13（固定: Teaching demo of symbology differences: comparing the use cases of Code128 (variable-length alphanumeric) and EAN-13 (fixed 13-digit retail code).
map.活动入场券与资产标签：为每张票或每台设备生成唯一码，现场扫码核销或盘点。: Event tickets and asset tags: generate a unique code for each ticket or device for on-site scanning, redemption or inventory.
map.：输入 12 位前缀 690123456789，工具按加权模 10 算出校验位: : entering the 12-digit prefix 690123456789, the tool computes check digit 2 by weighted modulo 10 and produces the full EAN-13 6901234567892; when printing, leave quiet zones of at least 9 times the narrowest bar width on each side or scanners will misread it.
